meta.title: JamBox — Independent app studio
meta.description: JamBox is an independent app studio in Seoul. We make software for the moments people gather — to play, to learn, and to belong.
meta.ogDescription: Independent app studio in Seoul. Makers of Boardhood and more.

hero.title: Software for the table we gather around.
hero.body: JamBox makes small, carefully packed apps for play, learning, and the rituals in between. We started with board games. We are building toward everything that brings people into the same room.

home.nowBody: A home for board game groups. Find a table, log the match, keep the collection, and stay close to the people you play with.
home.pillarPlayBody: Games are how strangers become a table. Boardhood treats matchmaking, records, and community as one craft.
home.pillarLearnBody: The same care belongs in study. We are building tools that make language practice feel like a session you want to return to.
home.pillarBelongBody: Every JamBox app should make it easier to show up — for a game night, a study streak, or the next thing we ship.
home.studioBody: Jam as in a session of making something together. Box as in a product small enough to hold. JamBox is the studio that ships those boxes from Seoul.
home.ctaBody: Support, press, and App Store questions all reach the same desk.

appsPage.title: Apps from JamBox
appsPage.body: We ship a few things, slowly, and we stand behind them. Live products sit beside work still on the table.
appsPage.boardhoodSummary: Find players, host rooms, track matches, and keep your collection — a board game community in one app.
appsPage.sharelogSummary: Save links on your device, optionally sync your private trail, and share selected content in shared folders.
appsPage.coffeenchatSummary: Professional connections that turn into conversations over coffee, in person or online.
appsPage.labSummary: Practice that feels like a gathering, not a grind. A companion for people who learn a language the way they keep a hobby — together, on a rhythm.

boardhood.title: Boardhood
boardhood.lede: Discover board game communities, meet players, and keep every match organized in one place.

boardhood.featureRecordsBody: Submit results, review history, follow your stats, and curate the games you own.
boardhood.supportBody: Boardhood is designed and operated by JamBox. Privacy, terms, and help live on this site so they stay with the studio — not a parked page.

sharelog.title: Sharelog
sharelog.availability: Available now on iOS and Android
sharelog.lede: A personal trail of the links and text you save. Capture on your device, sign in for shared folders, and choose whether to sync your private trail across devices.
sharelog.featureTrailBody: Shares land in one feed: All, To me, and To others. Add notes, memos, and categories, then search when you need them again.
sharelog.featurePrivateBody: Use a guest trail without an account. Sign in with Google, Apple, or Kakao for account features, then explicitly enable private sync or import guest saves when you choose.
sharelog.featureExportBody: Export or import your trail as JSON. Uninstalling the app does not delete an account or cloud data; use account deletion for that.
sharelog.supportBody: Read how local saves, sign-in, private sync, and shared folders use your information. You can also request account and associated-data deletion without installing the app.
sharelog.featureSharedBody: Collect selected links with other members. Shared items show who added them; personal notes and read status stay separate from the shared record.

about.title: About JamBox
about.lede: JamBox is an independent app studio based in Seoul, Republic of Korea. We design and operate consumer apps, beginning with Boardhood, and we will keep making products for play, learning, and belonging.
about.storyBody: The name is a jam session packed into a box: a small team making something you can actually hold. We care about analog rituals — a game on the table, a language practiced out loud — and we translate them into software that still feels human.
about.orgBody: This website is the public home of JamBox. The legal name, headquarters address, and contact below are the same details we use for our applications and developer accounts.

support.title: Support
support.lede: If something in a JamBox app is broken, confusing, or needs a human, write to us. We read every message.
support.emailBody: Include the app name, your device, and a short description of what happened. For account or privacy requests, say so in the subject line.
support.boardhoodBody: Match rooms, collections, sign-in, and notifications are handled from the same inbox. We also publish privacy and terms for Boardhood on this site.
support.sharelogBody: Sharelog supports guest saves, optional sign-in and private sync, and shared folders. Contact info@jambox.site for help, privacy questions, or account deletion.
support.responseBody: We are a small studio. We aim to reply within a few business days. We do not ask for passwords, and we will never require you to install software to receive help.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lede: JamBox is based in Gangseo-gu, Seoul. Reach us by email for support, partnerships, and developer-account matters.
contact.legalNote: Please use this address for official correspondence related to JamBox and its applications.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how JamBox (“JamBox”, “we”, “us”) collects, uses, and shares information when you use jambox.site and our applications, including Boardhood and Sharelog. It is written for people, not only for lawyers. Sharelog has an additional, app-specific policy at https://jambox.site/apps/sharelog/privacy.
privacy.s1Body: JamBox is an independent app studio. Registered address: 90, Magokjungang 8-ro, Gangseo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea. Contact: jaminthebox1226@gmail.com.
privacy.s2Body: jambox.site is a public organization website. We do not require an account to read it. Standard server logs (such as IP address, browser type, and pages requested) may be processed by our hosting provider to operate, secure, and understand traffic to the site. We do not sell website visitor data.
privacy.s3Body: When you use a JamBox application, the data processed depends on the app and features you choose. Boardhood may process device and usage information, account identifiers, and device location for nearby rooms and maps. Sharelog supports local guest saves, optional Google, Apple or Kakao sign-in, optional private cloud sync, and shared folders. Its account, content, technical-data and deletion practices are described in the Sharelog Privacy Policy at https://jambox.site/apps/sharelog/privacy. We do not knowingly solicit data from children under 13.
privacy.s4Body: We use information to provide the product you asked for, to keep accounts secure, to send service notices, to understand aggregated usage so we can improve the apps, and to respond when you contact us. Location in Boardhood is used for geolocation features, anonymized analytics, and, at times, transmission of anonymized location data to service providers who help us operate the app.
privacy.s5Body: Our applications may use third-party infrastructure that has its own privacy policies, including Google Play Services, Google Analytics for Firebase, and Firebase Crashlytics. We may disclose information when required by law, to protect safety or rights, or to trusted processors who may only use the data to provide services to JamBox.
privacy.s6Body: Retention and deletion depend on the application. Uninstalling an app does not delete an online account or cloud data. For Sharelog, see https://jambox.site/apps/sharelog/delete-account to request account and associated-data deletion, including information about retained deletion records. For other JamBox privacy requests, contact jaminthebox1226@gmail.com.
privacy.s7Body: JamBox apps are not directed at children under 13. If we learn that a child under 13 has provided personal information, we will delete it. Parents or guardians may contact us at the email above.
privacy.s8Body: We may update this policy. The current version will always be posted at jambox.site/privacy. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised policy.
privacy.s9Body: Privacy questions: jaminthebox1226@gmail.com. Postal: JamBox, 90, Magokjungang 8-ro, Gangseo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Sharelog is operated by JamBox, 90, Magokjungang 8-ro, Gangseo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea. For privacy questions, access or correction requests, and deletion support, contact info@jambox.site.

sections.title: Guest use and data on your device
paragraphs: You can save and organize links and text without an account. Guest saves, local photos, cached preview images, and app settings are kept on the device. Signing in opens a separate account trail; it does not automatically import or upload your guest saves. Importing guest saves and enabling private sync are explicit choices.

Sharelog can check the foreground clipboard for a link to offer a save prompt. The link is not added to your trail until you confirm. The last handled clipboard link may be stored locally to avoid repeated prompts, even if you dismiss the save. Files you choose to import or export are processed on the device; exported copies are under your control. Device or operating-system backups may retain local copies according to your backup settings.

sections.title: Optional sign-in and account information
paragraphs: Google, Apple, or Kakao sign-in is used for account features such as shared folders and private sync. Your chosen provider and Firebase Authentication process sign-in credentials, provider identifiers, a Sharelog user ID, and profile information supplied by the provider, such as a display name, email address, or profile-image URL. You can edit your display name in Sharelog.

We use this information to authenticate you, link your chosen sign-in methods, manage your account, and attribute contributions in shared folders. Sharelog’s server verifies Kakao credentials. We do not ask you to email a provider password or verification code.

sections.title: Optional private cloud sync
paragraphs: When you enable private sync, Firebase Cloud Firestore stores your account’s saved URLs and text, titles, descriptions, source and preview-image URLs, notes, categories, read status, and record identifiers and timestamps. This makes your private trail available on devices signed in to the same account.

Local photo files, downloaded image files, and device file paths are not uploaded by private sync. Turning sync off stops syncing on that device; it does not delete previously uploaded data. Signing out and uninstalling also do not delete your cloud trail.

sections.title: Shared folders, invitations, and links you send
paragraphs: Shared-folder data includes folder names, ownership and membership identifiers, display names, shared URLs and preview metadata, contributor attribution, and timestamps. Folder members can see shared content and attribution. Personal notes and read status are not included in shared item records; folder-specific notes, read status, and visibility preferences remain on your device in this version.
Anyone holding a valid folder invitation can preview the folder name, owner, and member count, then sign in and choose to join. Invitations can be revoked and normally expire after seven days.

One-time Sharelog links contain the selected link or saved text, an optional title and category, and a receipt identifier. They do not contain your private note field. These links are encoded, not encrypted: anyone receiving or forwarding one can read its contents. Recipients may retain their own copies even if you later delete your account.

sections.title: Network requests and service providers
paragraphs: Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, and Cloud Functions process account and cloud-feature data on JamBox’s behalf. Authentication and service requests may also process IP addresses, app and device information, service identifiers or tokens, and operational information to deliver the service and prevent abuse. Google, Apple, and Kakao process sign-in information under their own policies. Data may be processed outside your country.

Link previews and images are requested from the original website or public preview services. Those services receive the requested URL and ordinary connection information such as your IP address. Opening an original link sends you to that website. Sharing or exporting sends the content you select to your chosen destination. Share links include their content in the URL, which the link-hosting service receives; the Android install link can pass that payload through Google Play’s install-referrer service. The JamBox website may process standard server logs.

The app can request fonts from Google and check for updates through Google Play or Apple’s app services. These requests can include ordinary connection, device, app, or storefront information. These providers process requests under their own privacy policies.

We use the information to provide saves, sync and collaboration, manage and secure accounts, and respond to support or deletion requests. Sharelog does not sell your data, show in-app advertisements, or use your trail for cross-app advertising.

sections.title: How cloud data is protected
paragraphs: Account, private-sync, and shared-folder connections to Firebase use encrypted transport. Access controls restrict private cloud records to the account and shared-folder records to authorized members. This is not end-to-end encryption. Original websites and preview services control their own connections and policies; a saved web address can use HTTP rather than HTTPS.

sections.title: Your choices and deletion
paragraphs: Delete individual saves or open Settings → About → Delete all shares to clear personal saves for the active guest or account trail. With private sync enabled, those deletions sync to your other account devices. This does not delete shared folders or your account. Turning off sync is not a deletion request.

In the app, open Settings → Account → Delete account. Owned shared folders must first be transferred or deleted; the app checks this before confirming deletion and may ask you to sign in again. You can also request deletion through the public account-deletion page without installing or signing in to the app.

Account deletion removes the account profile and sign-in identity links, private cloud data, folder memberships, and your own shared-folder contributions. Contributions from other members remain in folders that continue to exist. After verifying deletion, the app clears the current account’s local records, settings, folder cache, and pending captures. Cached image or media files, other devices, and exports can retain copies. Uninstalling alone does not delete the account or cloud data.

sections.title: What is retained and for how long
paragraphs: Account and cloud content is kept until you delete it or request account deletion. Minimal records of deleted accounts and items, including identifiers and timestamps, are retained indefinitely to prevent old sessions, devices, or retried operations from restoring deleted data. These deletion records are separate from saved content; deleted URLs, text, notes, and category names are removed.

Firebase describes a separate cleanup period for authentication data: after deletion is initiated, it removes that data from live and backup systems within 180 days, and retains authentication IP logs for a few weeks. Other provider security and operational records follow the applicable provider retention policies. Copies you exported, operating-system backups, or copies kept by recipients are outside Sharelog’s account-deletion process.

If you email us, we use your contact information and request details to verify ownership and carry out the request. We complete email deletion requests within 30 days after account ownership is verified and any owned shared folders are transferred or deleted. We confirm the steps and completion by email. The separate provider cleanup periods described above can continue afterward.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: Sharelog is not directed at children under 13 or the equivalent minimum age in their country. If you believe a child has supplied personal information, contact info@jambox.site so we can investigate and arrange deletion.

sections.title: Policy changes and contact
paragraphs: We update this policy when Sharelog’s data practices change. The date above identifies the current version. Questions or requests about your information can be sent to info@jambox.site.

sharelogDeletion.title: Delete your Sharelog account
sharelogDeletion.lede: Request deletion of your Sharelog account and its associated data. You can use this page without signing in, installing, or reopening the app.
sharelogDeletion.emailBody: Send your request to info@jambox.site. Include the sign-in provider you used and the email address associated with your account, if one was supplied. A Sharelog user ID is helpful if you already know it, but is not required to send a request. If you cannot access that email or your account, explain that so we can help verify ownership.
sharelogDeletion.emailTemplate:
Hello JamBox,

Please delete my Sharelog account and its associated data.

Sign-in provider (Google, Apple, or Kakao):
Account email, if available:
Sharelog user ID, if known (optional):
Owned shared folders or access problems, if any:
sharelogDeletion.emailFallback: If the button does not open an email app, write to the address below from your email service with the subject “Sharelog account deletion request”. Opening the email draft does not send it; send the message to submit your request.
sharelogDeletion.verificationBody: We verify that the account belongs to you before deleting data. Never send passwords, verification codes, or access tokens. We complete your request within 30 days after ownership is verified and any owned shared folders are resolved, and confirm completion by email. If you own shared folders, their ownership must be transferred or the folders deleted; tell us in your request so we can help resolve this without requiring an app reinstall. Provider cleanup periods described below can continue after we complete the request.
sharelogDeletion.inAppTitle: You can also delete in the app
sharelogDeletion.inAppBody: Open Settings → Account → Delete account. Resolve any owned shared folders, confirm deletion, and complete the requested sign-in verification. Signing out, turning off sync, or uninstalling the app does not delete the account.
removedItems: Your Sharelog account profile and connected sign-in identities, including the Firebase Authentication account.
Your private cloud trail: saved links and text, notes, categories, read state, and associated account records.
Your shared-folder memberships and your own shared-folder contributions. Other members’ contributions remain in folders that continue to exist.
sharelogDeletion.retainedBody: Minimal deletion records containing identifiers and timestamps remain indefinitely to block old sessions and prevent deleted content from being restored. Deleted saved content is removed from those records. Firebase’s authentication cleanup can take up to 180 days across its live and backup systems; authentication IP logs are kept for a few weeks. Other provider operational records follow their retention policies. Exported files, operating-system backups, offline device copies, and copies held by recipients are not remotely erased by this request.
sharelogDeletion.localBody: After verifying deletion, the app clears the current account’s local records, settings, folder cache, and pending captures. Cached image or media files may remain. An email request cannot remotely erase files from an offline device, your guest trail, or exports. Remove those copies separately if needed. Deleting your Sharelog account does not delete your Google, Apple, or Kakao account.
